dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O'-shaped rings on the upper-mid flank exhibit irregular, jagged perimeters with high-contrast transitions from dark dorsal pixels to light interior centers; edges show variable thickness and non-linear boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of small, solid light-pixel clusters located between the larger macro-annuli and extending towards the posterior region, forming a dense, non-regularized field of high-contrast points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, with a secondary linear alignment of four smaller high-intensity blobs running parallel to the lower body curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced five-digit claw structure visible on the upward-facing pectoral flipper, characterized by high-intensity specular highlights against a dark focal region.
